info.title: API.SH: Breuninger
info.description: The Breuninger API from API.SH: public Breuninger data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Every colour of a product with each size's id, its availability in the chosen market (in stock, low stock = the shop shows only 1-2 left, out of stock) and the online quantity. A call for frequent stock checks; prices come from the product endpoint.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/breuninger-availability

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A breuninger.com product link (any storefront, e.g. /ch/fr/, /pl/, /it/en/); its market is used unless `country` is given. Give this or `id`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The 10-digit product id (in every product link, before /p/), e.g. `1001400439`.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Only this colour (the 32-character colour id). Default: every colour.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market (the shop's country storefront): sets the prices, the ISO currency (CHF for CH, PLN for PL, CZK for CZ, SEK for SE, DKK for DK, RON for RO, EUR elsewhere) and availability. Default: the link's market, else DE.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of names, labels and listing paths, where the market offers it: CH de/fr, BE nl/fr/en, NL nl/en, SE sv/en, DK da/en, RO ro/en; DE and AT de, PL pl, CZ cs, IE and the other markets en. Default: the link's language, else the market's first.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:

get.description:
One listing of the shop (a category such as damen/bekleidung/maentel, a brand page such as marken/max-mara, or a sale or new-in page) in one market: the same product cards as search, the total, every filter and sort order, and paging. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/breuninger-category

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A listing path from /breuninger/v1/categories (e.g. `damen/bekleidung/maentel`, `herren/schuhe/sneaker`, `marken/max-mara`). Give this or `url`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A breuninger.com listing link; its market, filters and sort are used unless given.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market (the shop's country storefront): sets the prices, the ISO currency (CHF for CH, PLN for PL, CZK for CZ, SEK for SE, DKK for DK, RON for RO, EUR elsewhere) and availability. Default: the link's market, else DE.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of names, labels and listing paths, where the market offers it: CH de/fr, BE nl/fr/en, NL nl/en, SE sv/en, DK da/en, RO ro/en; DE and AT de, PL pl, CZ cs, IE and the other markets en. Default: the link's language, else the market's first.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order. Default: relevance (the shop's own ranking).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (96 products a page). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Any shop filter as `group:value` from `facets` (repeatable, or several separated by `;`); several values of one group as `farbe:schwarz|blau`. Examples: `farbe:schwarz`, `marke:max-mara`, `groesse:38`, `material:wolle`, `rueckenlaenge:lang`.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand slug(s), e.g. `max-mara` or `boss|hugo`.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Colour group(s) in the storefront's language, e.g. `schwarz` (de), `noir` (fr), `black` (en); several as `schwarz|blau`. Values are in `facets`.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size(s) in stock, e.g. `38` or `M|L`.

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Only products available in this department store (`filter_value` from /breuninger/v1/stores), e.g. `stuttgart`. Offered on the German- and French-language storefronts.

parameters.name: sale
parameters.description: Only reduced products.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest price (whole number, market currency).

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest price (whole number, market currency).

parameters.name: facets
parameters.description: Also return the shop's filters with their values and counts (`facets`), the breadcrumb and the page title. Default false.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Breuninger product in one market (any of the shop's country storefronts: Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Poland, Czechia, the Netherlands, Belgium, Sweden, Denmark, Romania, Ireland, Italy, Spain and more): product id and colour id, brand, name, colour, price, original price, discount and lowest price of the last 30 days with the ISO currency (EUR, CHF, PLN, CZK, SEK, DKK or RON), every size with its size id, availability (in stock, low stock, out of stock), the online quantity and the low-stock message, the price per size and the delivery time per size; every other colour with its id, price and availability; gender, category path, description bullets, material, care, ingredients (beauty), delivery options with costs, manufacturer, EAN (single-variant items), images and the link. 404 when the product is not sold in that market.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/breuninger-product

get.description:
Products the shop recommends for a product: `similar` (similar products) or `outfit` (the shop's looks with the product: the look image and, for the chosen look, each piece by category with alternatives). Each card has product id, colour id, brand, name, price with currency, availability, link and image.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/breuninger-recommendations

get.description:
Search the shop of one market: every product card with product id, colour id, brand, name, colour, price, original price, discount, lowest price of the last 30 days and ISO currency, the sizes in stock, every colour with its price and sizes, sponsored flag, link and image. All shop filters, sort orders and paging are supported; `facets=true` adds the filter values with counts. Some searches open a brand or category page on the site: the response then names it in `redirect` and lists that page; a product number names the product. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/breuninger-search

get.description:
Every Breuninger department store with its id and the value for the listings' `store` filter (in-store availability), or one store's address, position, phone, opening hours and images.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/breuninger-stores

parameters.name: store

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
